decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of creatures and spells to push for damage quickly. With creatures like Scion of Draco and Territorial Kavu, as well as burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, the goal is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide support to the aggressive strategy, while cards like Stubborn Denial offer protection. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on and secure a swift victory before facing additional threats or disruption.

The main focus of this Jeskai Control deck is to control the board through counterspells and removal spells while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering key spells and removing threats with cards like Prismatic Ending and Solitude. Consign to Memory provides card advantage, while Wrath of the Skies and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury offer win conditions. The deck also includes various lands to fix mana and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent through aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, while also utilizing cards like Guide of Souls and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to support and buff its creatures. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the opponent's board and limit their options, ultimately leading to a quick victory.

This deck focuses on generating large amounts of mana quickly through rituals and mana fixing spells, casting cheap spells to draw cards and dig for combo pieces, and then casting Ral, Monsoon Mage to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck uses Past in Flames to recast spells from the graveyard and generate even more mana. The goal is to chain spells together to create a lethal storm of damage that overwhelms the opponent before they can respond. The deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and resources while maintaining card advantage and tempo through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Negation, it can disrupt the opponent's game plan and buy time to establish its own win condition. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude to apply pressure while still being able to interact with the opponent's plays. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility to support the control strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using powerful creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with support from Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge, the deck aims to quickly deal damage and control the board. The inclusion of cards like Arena of Glory and Thraben Charm helps to boost the creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's versatility and synergy between cards make it a formidable force in one-on-one Modern matchups.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creature toolbox options to enable a combo win condition. It includes creatures that can be sacrificed for various effects, along with cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for specific creatures. The deck also incorporates mana acceleration with cards like Gilded Goose and Wall of Roots, as well as disruption with Viscera Seer and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. The goal is to outvalue the opponent through a versatile and synergistic collection of creatures and combo interactions.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through removal spells, counterspells, and cards that disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to generate card advantage through cards like Stock Up and Nulldrifter while using Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt the opponent's plays and protect key cards. The win condition of the deck revolves around playing powerful threats like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and closing out the game with cards like Consign to Memory and Wrath of the Skies. The mana base is optimized to support the three-color Jeskai Control strategy.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive creature plays combined with burn spells to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of resilient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison to control the board and protect your creatures. By maintaining constant pressure and leveraging efficient removal spells, this deck aims to close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this Lantern Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by controlling their draws, limiting their ability to attack with Ensnaring Bridge, disrupting their hand with discard spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, and locking them out of certain cards or strategies with cards like Pithing Needle and Grafdigger's Cage. The deck also utilizes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while using Urza's Saga to tutor for important artifacts to further control the game. Overall, the deck focuses on complete control and disruption to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Allosaurus Rider combo by using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Neoform to tutor for key pieces. The goal is to get Allosaurus Rider onto the battlefield, then use Nourishing Shoal to gain a massive amount of life and cast Summoner's Pact to find and cast Griselbrand for free. Xenagos, God of Revels and Atraxa, Grand Unifier can help provide additional support and power on the battlefield, while cards like Planar Genesis and Disciple of Freyalise can help generate additional resources to keep the combo going.

This deck focuses on aggressively deploying creatures like Emperor of Bones and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, while utilizing blink effects such as Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to gain value and protect key pieces. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's game plan. By taking advantage of blink effects and aggressive creature plays, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells, while also generating incremental advantage through blinking and recurring key creatures.

This Allosaurus Combo deck focuses on quickly assembling the necessary pieces to combo off and win the game in a single explosive turn. Using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Neoform, the deck can tutor up key creatures like Allosaurus Rider and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant to generate a massive amount of mana and power on the board. By utilizing cards like Consign to Memory and Generous Ent to dig for combo pieces and disrupt opponent's strategies, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its powerful creatures and win the game before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies with a diverse mana base to support a variety of powerful spells. Utilizing Leyline cards to control the board, along with versatile creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game. With access to powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, along with counter magic like Stubborn Denial, this deck is designed to disrupt the opponent while building towards a fast and lethal victory.

The deck aims to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Leyline Binding, while utilizing Glimpse of Tomorrow to potentially cheat out powerful creatures like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines without paying their mana cost. The strategy revolves around using Shardless Agent to cascade into powerful spells, along with using Risen Reef to generate card advantage and ramp. The deck also includes cards like Solitude and Endurance for removal and disruption, making it a versatile combo deck that can win through overwhelming board presence or a powerful combo finish.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It also utilizes spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to control the board and protect its creatures. Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact help to further boost the aggression of the deck. Consign to Memory provides some flexibility and card draw. The mana base is designed to support the multiple colors of the deck, with a mix of fetch lands and shock lands.
